id: 628-第二次卡拉科爾-納蘭霍戰爭
theater: 貝里斯—洪都拉斯邊境山區

battle.name: 第二次卡拉科爾-納蘭霍戰爭
battle.theater: 貝里斯—洪都拉斯邊境山區
battle.brief: 公元六二八年，貝里斯瑪雅山脈北麓的卡拉克穆爾與洪都拉斯科潘河谷納蘭霍再啟兵端，這是前一年衝突未了的第二次「星戰」，各遣遠征軍沿佩滕—科潘古道深入腹地，奪路、焚屋、俘將。卡面的科林斯青銅盔屬古典地中海裝備，未曾出現在瑪雅戰場；與之功能相當的，是佩特工的擲矛手與花紋圓盾結成的正面。

kit.name: 科林斯青銅盔
kit.history: 全正面開眼的青銅盔。看得見的代價是：戴它的人只能靠隊形活。

countries: 這場戰爭發生於公元六二八年，戰場在瑪雅文明東南部的兩片山城之間。一座是卡拉克穆爾（Caracol，碑銘作「三人石之地」），位於今貝里斯凱奧區瑪雅山脈北麓的丘陵台地，核心建築群「天宮」（Caana）高踞台地最高處；另一座是納蘭霍（Naranjo，碑銘中的瑪雅名作 Naranj Ha），在今洪都拉斯科潘省科潘河谷內，建築群沿 El Zapotal 一帶的山脊與階梯台地鋪開。交戰一方是卡拉克穆爾的 K'inich 王族，以「三人石之主」的名號向東南低地發動遠征；另一方是納蘭霍的伊察姆坎（Itz'am K'an）王朝，該王朝自六世紀末起便以「星戰」聞名，先後與卡安努爾、埃爾佩魯等城邦聯手遠征。卡拉克穆爾的兵員由王畿村落的常備與民兵抽調，骨幹為佩槍的貴族精英，另有持擲矛器、弓矢的步兵以及少量投石手；納蘭霍同樣以佩槍突擊隊為核心，配以弓手、擲矛手與持黑曜石柄劍的近戰兵。第三方是蒂卡爾、卡安努爾與埃爾佩魯等城邦，它們多未直接出兵，卻是這條商路上的角力者與盟友義務的當事人。現存碑銘與考古材料都沒有留下本役的雙方兵員、陣亡與戰損數字，能夠確定的只是它的發起者、交戰地點與大致勝負方向。
countriesEn: This war broke out in AD 628 between two Maya city-states of the southeastern lowlands. One was Caracol, whose glyphic name is written as the Place of Three Stones, standing on a hilltop terrace in the foothills of the Maya Mountains in the Cayo District of present-day Belize, its core building group, the Caana or Sky Palace, crowning the highest ground; the other was Naranjo, whose monuments spread along the ridges and stepped terraces of the Zapotal zone inside the Copan valley in today's Copan Department of Honduras. One side was the K'inich royal line of Caracol, which marched out of the Three-Stone capital on expeditions into the southeast; the other was the Itz'am K'an dynasty of Naranjo, a house that had been famous for its star wars since the late sixth century and had earlier marched in company with Kaanul and El Peru. Caracol drew its troops from the standing levies and the militia of its own heartland villages, with dart-throwing noble warriors forming the backbone, backed by atlatl and bow infantry and a few slingers; Naranjo was built the same way, around spear-bearing assault companies supported by archers, dart throwers and close-combat men with obsidian-bladed wooden swords. Third parties were cities such as Tikal, Kaanul and El Peru, which mostly kept their hands off the fighting yet remained the parties contending over the trade routes and the source of binding alliance obligations. Neither the surviving stelae nor the archaeological material preserves any headcount, casualty or loss figure for this war: what can be established is who launched it, where it was fought, and roughly which way it turned.
people: 可點名的人不多，而且多數出自碑銘。卡拉克穆爾一側是 K'inich 王族，後世最著名的一位是 K'inich Yax K'uk' Mo'（約公元六六○至六七九年在位，漢譯多作「鷹豹」），他在一九八五年被發掘的陵墓中出土了帶「特奧蒂瓦卡式」護目符神面圖案的盾牌，以及一件與之配套的年輕戰士遺骸，說明這條王線自六世紀末起便自居「戰神附身者」，並以攻擊鄰邦作為王權的正當性來源；不過他在世時已晚於本役，他陵墓所反映的戰爭傳統，正是這場六二八年衝突的直接延續。納蘭霍一側是伊察姆坎王朝的君主與「星戰」統帥，但現存可辨的王名多只剩稱號與簡寫，具體人物要靠碑銘中的王系與「星戰」事件對照推得。除此之外，雙方都有大批在碑文裡不留姓名的角色：主持儀式的祭司、抄寫王族戰功的書記、在前線指揮佩槍突擊的貴族隊長、負責談判俘虜贖回的中人，以及隨軍搬運糧秣與器物的勞役隊。第三方城邦的干預者同樣匿名：蒂卡爾與埃爾佩魯的貴族在幕後支應同盟義務，卻避免留下可被追責的銘文。換言之，本役的關鍵決策多由王族與祭司團體在城郊完成，真正改變局勢的，是能不能把遠征隊送到對方城下的那幾位領隊，以及願意為俘虜贖金與禮儀重做而再啟一場遠征的人。
peopleEn: Few individuals can be named, and most of them come from the monuments. On the Caracol side there is the K'inich royal line; its best known figure is K'inich Yax K'uk' Mo' (reigned roughly AD 660 to 679, rendered in Chinese as the Owl Jaguar), whose tomb, excavated in 1985, yielded a shield bearing the goggle-eyed deity mask of the Teotihuacan style together with the remains of a young warrior equipped to match, showing that this line had presented itself as the vessel of the war god since the late sixth century and had built the right to rule on the subjugation of its neighbours; he was, however, born long after this war, and the warlike image his tomb displays is the direct continuation of the conflict fought in 628. On the Naranjo side were the monarchs of the Itz'am K'an dynasty and the commanders of its star wars, but almost no personal name survives except a title or an abbreviated form, and the individuals have to be reconstructed by matching the dynastic sequences in the monuments against the star war episodes they record. Around both sides stand a host of figures who left no names on the stone: the priests who conducted the rites, the scribes who wrote down the royal exploits, the noble captains who led the spear charges in the field, the middlemen who negotiated the ransom of captives, and the porters who hauled grain and gear behind the army. The interveners from the third-party cities are equally anonymous: nobles in Tikal and El Peru supported alliance obligations from behind the scenes while avoiding any inscription that could be held against them. In short, the decisive choices in this war were made by royal houses and priestly colleges outside the city, and what actually decided the outcome was whether the expedition leaders could bring their columns under the enemy walls, and whether anyone was willing to pay the ransom for captives and to redo the ceremony in order to launch yet another march.
kits: 卡面所列的科林斯青銅盔（Corinthian helmet，約公元前六五○年，希臘）是這套卡牌為本役指派的裝備，但必須說明：青銅冶煉與地中海的盔式從未進入中美洲，這頂全正面開眼的銅盔並沒有出現在公元六二八年的瑪雅戰場。與它在戰役中真正對應的，是佩特（Pete）一系戰士的整套裝束：以擲矛器（atlatl）投出的細長木矛、複合弓與三角箭鏃、嵌黑曜石片的木柄短劍（macuahuitl），以及以木框柳條蒙皮、覆以棉布並綴羽的圓盾；護體靠層層棉布纏裹與獵豹皮背心的組合，頭部多纏布巾或戴獸皮、木製的頭套，部分貴族飾以代表雨神恰克與戰神面具的青玉與貝殼拼貼。科林斯盔的功能要點——只有正面可倚仗、兩翼與後腦是弱面——在瑪雅戰術裡對應的正是「以整列遮蔽」的投射正面：擲矛手成排齊射，盾牌相接頂住對方躍前的佩槍手，單兵並不打算靠裝甲硬扛。攻城裝備包括木梯、繩索、可拆卸的柵架與火攻草束：瑪雅建築多為木構加茅草頂，一經點燃便難以撲救。運輸方面沒有可用的馭獸，糧秣、矛束與繩梯全靠人力背扛，渡科潘河與烏拉河時改用小舟；弓弦、燧石與陶器則就地補充。
kitsEn: The Corinthian bronze helmet named on the card (Corinthian helmet, about 650 BC, Greek) is the equipment this deck assigns to the battle, but it has to be said plainly: bronze smelting and Mediterranean headgear never reached Middle America, and this bronze helm with its open face was not present on any Maya battlefield in AD 628. What actually corresponds to it in the war are the full kit of the Pete line of warriors: slender wooden darts thrown from an atlatl, composite bows with triangular arrowheads, obsidian blades set into wooden handles as the macuahuitl club-sword, and round shields of wood and wicker covered with hide and cloth and trimmed with feathers; protection for the body came from layered cotton padding combined with jaguar-pelt vests, while the head was wrapped in cloth or covered with hide or wooden caps, and some nobles wore mosaic work of greenstone and shell standing for the rain god Chac and for war masks. The functional point of the Corinthian helm, that only the front can be leaned upon while the flanks and the back of the head are weak, corresponds in Maya tactics to the projecting front that is shielded as a whole line: rows of dart throwers fire in unison, shields are locked together against the leaping spearmen, and the individual warrior never expects his own armour to absorb the impact. Siege equipment included wooden ladders, rope, demountable scaffolds and bundles of burning thatch: Maya buildings were timber-framed with thatched roofs, and once lit they could hardly be saved. For transport there was no draft animal at all; grain, dart bundles and rope ladders travelled on human backs, and the crossing of the Copan and Ulua rivers was made in small canoes, while bowstrings, flints and pottery were replenished on the spot.
tactics: 瑪雅人的戰爭是儀式與實力交織的東西。所謂「星戰」（star war）並非單純的比武，而是一場被星辰與雨神恰克指定義務的攻擊：宣戰與誓師要挑日子，出兵要挑旱季，攻入城後須俘獲對方君主或貴族、焚其偶像，並把「零」刻在石碑上宣告對方被抹去。依此役所處的走廊推斷，卡拉克穆爾自西向東沿佩滕南緣與科潘河谷北側的古道推進，納蘭霍則由東段山脊迎擊；古道沒有可供車馬通行的寬路，遠征隊只能輕裝先鋒在前、糧秣隊與俘虜隊在後，行程被山脊與溪流切斷，雨季連日行軍與缺水是最大負擔。接戰多在城前廣場與台地邊緣：擲矛手在數十步至百步外排成散兵線齊射，弓手分佔兩翼，佩槍手以圓盾護身前進，接近後改用短劍與石斧貼身廝殺；貴族之間往往先以單挑定勝負，把對方王族劫走作為戰果與贖金。攻城時先斷水源與田禾，再點燃倉房，最後以梯與繩索攀上台地。撤退則是有計畫的破壞：砍伐果樹、焚燒田舍、遷走人口，使對方在下一個收成季失去稅基。雲雨、溪澗與密林是雙方共同的障礙，因此縱火與破壞多集中於可燃的建築，而非夯土或石砌的核心。
tacticsEn: Maya warfare is a thing in which ritual and force are woven together. A star war is not simply a duel but an attack imposed as an obligation by the stars and the rain god Chac: the declaration and the muster must be set on the right day, the army must march in the dry season, and once inside the enemy city the attackers must take the opposing lord or nobles captive, burn their effigies, and carve the zero on a stele to announce that the enemy has been unmade. Judging from the corridor in which this war was fought, Caracol advanced from the west along the old road past the southern edge of Peten and the north side of the Copan valley, while Naranjo came to meet it from the ridges further east; the old road was no wide track for carts or horses, so an expedition could travel only with a light vanguard in front and the grain train and the column of captives behind, the march being cut by ridges and streams, with days of rain in the wet season and the shortage of water as the heaviest burden. Contact was usually made on the plaza before the city and along the edges of the terraces: dart throwers fired in loose order from several dozen to a hundred paces, archers took the flanks, and the spearmen advanced behind locked round shields, switching to the short wooden sword and the stone axe once they closed. Among the nobles a single combat often settled the matter, and carrying off the opposing royal kinsman was both the trophy and the ransom. When besieging, the attackers first cut off the water and the crops, then fired the storehouses, and only at the end climbed the terraces with ladders and rope. Withdrawal was a planned destruction: fruit trees were cut down, farmsteads burned, people moved off, so that the enemy would lose its tax base in the following harvest. Cloudbursts, streams and dense forest were obstacles shared by both sides, and for that reason the burning and the damage were concentrated on the flammable buildings rather than on the rammed-earth or stone core.
data: 可引的數字不多，而且多屬估算。卡拉克穆爾約在北緯十六度四十六分、西經八十九度十二分，納蘭霍約在北緯十四度五十二分、西經八十九度八分，兩地直線相距約二百一十公里，循古道繞行則超過二百五十公里，遠征隊連同糧秣隊在內，一般要走八至十二日才能抵達城下。城邦人口方面，一般把卡拉克穆爾核心聚落於盛期的人口放在數萬量級，納蘭霍的聚落規模相近，多集中於山頂主廣場與 El Zapotal 一帶。遠征兵力多半落在數百至數千名戰士之間，其中佩槍的貴族精英通常只有數十至數百人；可作參照的是公元三七八年納蘭霍聯同埃爾佩魯、卡安努爾遠征蒂卡爾時，學界對參與人數給出的寬鬆區間也在數千人上下，並無更精確的憑據。碑刻方面，納蘭霍三十三號石碑記錄了對卡拉克穆爾的「星戰」與長期爭端，蒂卡爾三十一號石碑（公元四四五年立）記錄了三七八年那一場轟動一時的襲擊，而蒂卡爾後來所立的三十一號石碑（公元七四三年）記錄了卡拉克穆爾的覆亡。就時間而言，本役屬於旱季出兵的傳統，哈布曆第九月 Ch'en 對應的公曆約在十二月下旬至一月中旬，戰爭列表所記的十二月因此只能視為約數。合計損失數字沒有任何來源可以支撐，只宜說兩城各有相當數量的建築被焚、村落人口外流。
dataEn: The figures that can be cited are few, and most of them are estimates. Caracol lies at about 16 degrees 46 minutes north, 89 degrees 12 minutes west, and Naranjo at about 14 degrees 52 minutes north, 89 degrees 8 minutes west; the two are roughly 210 kilometres apart in a straight line, and rather more than 250 kilometres if the old road is followed, so an expedition with its grain train generally needed eight to twelve days to reach the enemy walls. On population, the heartland settlement of Caracol at its height is usually put in the tens of thousands, and Naranjo was of comparable size, concentrated on the main hilltop plaza and in the Zapotal zone. Expedition strength usually fell somewhere between several hundred and several thousand warriors, of whom the spear-bearing noble elite numbered perhaps several dozen to several hundred; for comparison, when Naranjo marched on Tikal in AD 378 together with El Peru and Kaanul, the loose ranges offered by scholars for the number of participants also run into the thousands, and no firmer evidence exists. On the monuments: Stela 33 at Naranjo records a star war against Caracol and a long quarrel, Stela 31 at Tikal, erected in AD 445, records the sensational attack of AD 378, and the later Stela 31 at Tikal, raised in AD 743, records the fall of Caracol. As to timing, this war belongs to the tradition of campaigning in the dry season; the ninth Haab month, Ch'en, corresponds to roughly late December through mid-January in the modern calendar, so the month of December given in the war lists can only be taken as an approximation. No source supports an aggregate loss figure, and the only safe statement is that a considerable number of buildings in both cities were burned and that population moved out of the villages.
cause: 打起來有幾層原因，最表面的是前一年第一次交鋒留下的未了之事。瑪雅人的「星戰」是一種帶義務的襲擊：一旦宣戰並燒了對方首領的偶像，衝突便不算結束，直到雙方互換俘虜、首領歸位、儀式走完；前一年沒有完成的部分，成了再戰的口實。深一層是區域霸權之爭：納蘭霍的伊察姆坎王朝自六世紀末起主導東南低地，屢次以「星戰」向西部城邦施壓，而卡拉克穆爾的 K'inich 王族不甘於困守貝里斯山麓，欲把勢力伸向科潘河谷。再深一層是商路與物資：貝里斯山區通往佩滕的鹽、埃爾查亞爾的黑曜石、莫塔瓜河谷的玉、科潘低地的可可與棉花，構成這條走廊的交換骨架；誰控制山口與渡口，誰就抽得出關稅與貢賦，戰爭因而是貿易權的爭奪。此外還有農業與漁獵營地的邊界之爭——旱季與雨季的季節性漁場、獵場與果園是城邦之間最容易越界的東西。最後是象徵層面的競爭：納蘭霍與卡拉克穆爾都自居「戰神在位者」，都需要用一次成功的「星戰」證明自己的正統；對手越是被神話化，這一場敗績就越不能容忍。
causeEn: There are several layers of reason behind the fighting, the outermost of them being what was left unfinished by the first clash of the previous year. For the Maya a star war was an attack carrying an obligation: once war was declared and the effigy of the opposing chief burned, the conflict was not over until the captives had been exchanged, the lords returned and the rite completed; what did not get done in the first year became the pretext for the second. One level deeper lies the struggle over regional primacy: the Itz'am K'an dynasty of Naranjo had led the southeastern lowlands since the late sixth century, pressing westward city-states with repeated star wars, while the K'inich line of Caracol was unwilling to stay penned inside the Belizean foothills and wanted to push its power down into the Copan valley. Deeper still are the trade routes and the goods that moved on them: the salt of the Belizean highlands, the obsidian of El Chayal, the jade of the Motagua valley, the cacao and cotton of the Copan lowland made up the exchange skeleton of this corridor, and whoever held the passes and the fords could levy tolls and tribute, so that the war was a struggle over the right to trade. Added to this were boundary disputes over farming and over the seasonal fishing and hunting camps, for the dry-season and wet-season fishing grounds, hunting grounds and orchards were the things most easily crossed by a rival city. Last of all came the competition in symbols: both Naranjo and Caracol claimed to be the one in whom the war god resided, and each needed one successful star war to prove its legitimacy; the more mythological the rival was made, the less tolerable a defeat at its hands could be.
impact: 直接效果是東南低地的權力版圖被改寫。納蘭霍在這次及其後的幾次交鋒中被削弱：El Zapotal 區與主廣場的居民大量外移，耕地廢耕，貴族墓葬與銘刻的規格一路下滑，直到七世紀末該城再未回到六世紀的規模；曾經寫滿「星戰」豐功的三十三號石碑，後來淪為一段不再被援引的舊事。卡拉克穆爾則坐實了在貝里斯—佩滕地區的霸主地位，並把特奧蒂瓦卡式的戰爭面具與「星戰」神話納入王權宣傳，K'inich Yax K'uk' Mo' 陵墓所展示的精英形象正是這條宣傳線的頂點。戰爭的直接代價落在兩條山地的社會上：田禾與倉房被焚、果樹被砍、勞役隊伍被拉長，許多村落人口在饑荒與遷徙中耗損，戰俘的贖回與再安置成為城邦之間長期的外交負擔。長期看，這場衝突是「東南最後一個星戰強權被打斷」的過程中的一環：卡拉克穆爾在七三〇年代敗於蒂卡爾與烏塔特蘭的聯盟，賈索·錢·卡維爾一世把它壓到崩潰，納蘭霍再也沒有復國；學界今日談論瑪雅戰爭時，也常以這段戰爭檢驗「儀式性衝突」與「實質城市戰爭」之間的比例，因為它既留下大規模破壞的考古痕跡，也留下明確的儀式敘事。
impactEn: The immediate effect was a rewriting of the power map of the southeastern lowlands. Naranjo was weakened in this war and in the clashes that followed: residents of the Zapotal zone and of the main plaza moved away in numbers, fields were abandoned, and the scale of the noble tombs and of the inscriptions declined steadily, until by the end of the seventh century the city never regained its sixth-century scale; Stela 33, once covered with the exploits of star wars, became an old matter no longer cited. Caracol, for its part, confirmed its primacy in the Belize-Peten region and folded the Teotihuacan-style war masks and the myth of the star war into its royal propaganda, the elite image displayed in the tomb of K'inich Yax K'uk' Mo' being the summit of that line of self-presentation. The immediate costs fell on the societies of the two uplands: crops and storehouses burned, fruit trees cut, labour columns stretched, and in many villages population was worn down by hunger and displacement, while the ransom and resettlement of captives became a long diplomatic burden between the cities. In the long run this conflict forms one link in the process by which the last great star war power of the southeast was broken: Caracol itself fell in the 730s to the coalition of Tikal and Uzatlan under Jasaw Chan K'awiil I, and Naranjo was never restored. Even today, when scholars discuss Maya warfare, this war is used to test the proportion between ritualised confrontation and real urban war, because it left both large-scale archaeological traces of destruction and a clearly ritualised narrative.
result: 就現有材料可判斷的方向看，這一仗以卡拉克穆爾取勝告一段落：納蘭霍的遠征能力被打斷，其後不再有成功的「星戰」記錄，該城在七世紀末走向廢棄，只在古典期尾聲有過規模小得多的再占。但勝負並未就此收束：六三一年的第三次、六三六年的第四次、六八○年的第五次交鋒，說明雙方的「星戰」義務還在延續，只是方向逐漸由納蘭霍進攻轉為防守與反制。卡拉克穆爾本身也沒有走得更遠——七三〇年代它在蒂卡爾—烏塔特蘭聯盟與賈索·錢·卡維爾一世的攻勢下崩解，公元七四三年蒂卡爾三十一號石碑記錄了它的敗亡，廢墟最終在九世紀被完全拋棄；納蘭霍則更早退場，其舊址在往後一千餘年間只剩殘存的石柱與土台。總結而言，這場公元六二八年的戰爭在當下換來了卡拉克穆爾的勝利與東南低地的短暫重排，在史冊上則留下另一種意義：它說明瑪雅城邦之間的「星戰」可以摧毀一座城，卻無法替摧毀者買到太平。真正解決這段走廊權力格局的，還是半個多世紀後蒂卡爾與卡拉克穆爾之間的那一場決戰。
resultEn: On what the surviving material allows us to judge, the battle ended in a victory for Caracol: Naranjo's capacity to project force was broken, it recorded no further successful star war, and the city slid towards abandonment by the end of the seventh century, returning only at a far smaller scale in the late Classic period. But the matter did not close there: the third war of 631, the fourth of 636 and the fifth of 680 show that the star war obligations of both sides continued, only that the direction of the fighting gradually turned from a Naranjo offensive into defence and counter-stroke. Caracol itself did not go far either: in the 730s it came apart under the coalition of Tikal and Uzatlan and the offensive of Jasaw Chan K'awiil I, Tikal's Stela 31 of AD 743 recording its defeat, and the ruins were finally abandoned in the ninth century; Naranjo quit the stage even earlier, and for more than a thousand years afterwards its site held nothing but standing stones and platform mounds. In sum, the war of AD 628 bought Caracol a victory and a brief reordering of the southeastern lowlands at the time, but in the historical record it carries a different meaning: it shows that the star war between Maya city-states could destroy a city, yet could not buy the destroyer any peace. What actually settled the power pattern of this corridor was the decisive battle fought between Tikal and Caracol half a century later.
